title: Chapter 29 Sweeping
content:
Chapter 29 Sweeping

However, that Andy patriarch soon regretted it. Because he found out, where is the army under the leader of the alliance, all of them are a group of strange humans with yellow skin.

They were far away just now, and they were wearing armor again, with some wooden masks on their faces. They didn't look very friendly for a while. They were urged by the elder Tenny, and their minds were disturbed, so they tricked them into opening the door. .

These strange yellow-skinned troops, after about a hundred people entered the tribe, immediately took control of the dangerous places in the tribe. However, Patriarch Andy didn't care too much, because some of the more elite troops, in unfamiliar places, have no problem to be cautious.

However, after those unfamiliar troops controlled themselves to avoid dangerous places, they immediately turned their weapons against their own people and themselves.

Taking advantage of his carelessness and caution, he controlled his tribe unexpectedly, and all the tribesmen became prisoners of the army. Without any resistance, the entire tribe was easily captured by others.

In the end, in the smiling expression of the elder Tenny, he told himself the whole thing and the reason in a very pleasant tone.

Patriarch Andy felt a burst of despair, God, what kind of army is this? It is too daring to overthrow the army of tens of thousands of tribal alliance leaders with only a few hundred people to establish a new regime and become the new overlord of this area. It is crazy.

However, just when Patriarch Andy wanted to refuse directly and join the army. Elder Tenny seemed to see the thoughts of Patriarch Andy and said bluntly.

"My master, who is the leader of this army, wants me to tell you, the clan leaders of these tribes, that if you surrender, then he will only select the warriors of your tribe and go with him on the expedition. If you refuse to surrender, Then all people will become slaves, and they will never be able to stand up. Men will work for them day and night until they die of exhaustion. And there is no right to mate, and women will be given to their warriors by him, to reward their bravery."

Hearing Elder Tainey's words, Patriarch Andy was full of anger and despair. Do he really want to obey this army? Send them away from their tyrannical rule? Give up your tribe to them and become a part of their tribe? Is the tribe that has been passed down for so long dying at my hands?

Finally, after thinking about it for a while in Patriarch Andy's heart, although he was full of reluctance, he still chose to obey. He still chose the latter wisely.

In less than an hour, the army chose to surrender after opening the door, but in less than an hour, Zhong Yu gained a population of more than 50, which made him very happy. It was so smooth once, does this indicate that it will be smooth sailing for me in the future?

Leaving a ten-person army to guard and escort them, the remaining thirty people of this tribe went to the Aisen tribe to build the city. Zhong Yu took the army of fifteen people drawn from this tribe and continued to follow his army.

In this way, along the way, the leaders or elders of the tribes along the road were used to constantly deceive the defenses of those tribes, and the flag of the tribe alliance army was used to open their defenses, making them unwittingly become Zhong Yu's prisoners. .

Zhong Yu continued to move forward. After a day, on the way, a small tribe rested for the night. Zhong Yu had already cheated. There were about twenty tribes, including two tribes with a population of more than 100. The population obtained was about Thousands or so.

The three hundred people who were drawn from inside came out and continued to follow the army. The remaining people, Zhong Yu, sent two hundred young soldiers to escort them back to the stronghold of the Aisen tribe, where they built the city and acted as labor.

At this time, Zhong Yu was left with only 100 Guards cavalry, about 100 strong soldiers and those Yellow Turban slaves, while there were more than 300 barbarian servants beside him.

The next day, Zhong Yu's army had gathered and continued to set off, and continued to sweep more than a dozen tribes, and obtained a population of 700 people, from which 200 troops were drawn, and the remaining 500 people made the remaining strong The soldiers and the Yellow Turban slave army all rhymed back.

At this moment, there were only 100 cavalry around Zhong Yu to suppress that, and the number of barbarian servants was as high as more than 500. The situation is already very delicate.

Zhong Yu has already felt that the hearts of those barbarians are a little bit restless. He decided that in the end, after sweeping up a few tribes, he immediately regrouped and returned to the army.

While their deterrence is still lingering in their hearts, rush back to the stronghold of the Aisen tribe to build the city as soon as possible, and will work with those strong soldiers to increase their deterrence, suppress those barbarian servants, and make them dare not act rashly. .

However, before that, some actions should be adopted to make them fear themselves more in their hearts to avoid some unnecessary situations.

"Da da da!" A sound of horses' hoofs flashed quickly, and hundreds of knights swept across the road. A few tribal savages in different costumes followed quickly behind them.

At this moment, the faces of those tribal barbarians were full of complaining expressions, and some angry emotions could not stop appearing in their hearts, and there was a faint feeling that they were about to burst out.

However, Zhong Yu's destination was about to arrive. There was a tribe of two hundred people in front of him. Zhong Yu did not cheat their defenses as before, but came directly on horseback. .

With the group of tribes caught off guard, with expressions of consternation and horror on their faces, Zhong Yu beat the horse two hundred meters in front of the door.

"I am the leader of the Luoyang tribe, and now I am leading the demon army to ask you to submit to my feet. I will lead you to overthrow the rule of the Edra tribe alliance. If you know each other, put down your weapons and open the door to surrender, otherwise , everyone will be shot to death."

Zhong Yu's cold and heartless words sounded in the ears of everyone in this tribe, filling their hearts with bursts of anger, eager to open the door immediately and rush out to fight them to the death.

Such rude and cruel conditions were uttered by Zhong Yu in an orderly tone, and anyone with some blood and strength would not readily agree, so this tribe rightfully rejected Zhong Yu's surrender.

But this is also what Zhong Yu wants. If it doesn't pass a real war, like it has more than 500 barbarian servants, how can it make them obey him obediently The order, don't make trouble on the way back!

After being rejected, Zhong Yu didn't speak, but waited quietly in front of the door with his cavalry, waiting for the servants to arrive, and assembled well to watch his performance.

And taking advantage of this period of time, the leader of that tribe also gathered nearly 50 troops to guard the gate above the camp.

The atmosphere solidified for a while, full of chills, and everyone evacuated themselves, complaining, laughing, or other faces. All that was left were expressions of fear, panic, or seriousness.

Zhong Yu - If you want to control the number of people far beyond your own, then it may be a good way to make them feel afraid.
